items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yes, I had Ted Kurland for ten years, but he never got me any gigs.

ctx.x: Did you have any state-side representation where the band played?

Yes, I had Ted Kurland for ten years, but he never got me any gigs. But I didn’t want any gigs. I didn’t like to play in person. Once I got through the Jack Bruce stage and realized it was not gonna be what it was, rock and roll had that to speak for it. But Jazz had the worst hotel in town, and eating whatever band slop was given to you by the club owner, and losing a lot of money by having excess baggage. But after ten years it was better. We actually made some money. And Thomas Stowsand stayed with us until we…
So who in those early days in the band, some of those players in the band that you can recall?
